title: Boomtown
description: Not every outpost needs constant supply. Seed a boomtown and let it grow on its own — but it still needs cargo from somewhere.

narrative.intro: This outpost site is different: found it with a founding settler already there, and left alone it grows on its own — no builder route required. That doesn't mean it's self-sufficient, though. It still needs cargo shipped in from home base like anything else.
narrative.outro: Growth and supply turned out to be two separate problems with two separate solutions — one you set up once and walked away from, one you had to keep running. Knowing which is which is most of what running a network actually is.

goals.description: Let the boomtown's population grow to at least 8 on its own.
